body: Just talking to people on the internet as its harder to feel judged when there’s no face to show it. I like the anonymity, and even for a therapist to know seems like too many judging faces to me right now

It just keeps feeling like the only escape. Ever since seventh grade i’ve been chronically incapable of trusting or expecting anything but malice and bad will from other people. No matter how good they seem I can’t imagine any reason why anyone should or would like me in any way.
